key_insight: DeepQuest turns Alzheimer's research knowledge gaps into testable hypotheses, linking automated experiments to traceable, evidence-supported findings.
engineering_relevance: Research-agent pipelines can prioritize useful experiments by combining data-feasibility checks with separate audits of experimental reliability and knowledge contribution.
method: Extract unresolved questions from domain reviews and convert them into traceable hypotheses.
Screen hypotheses for data feasibility and prioritize them through groupwise Elo ranking.
Run iterative experiments and audit reliability and knowledge contribution against two frozen literature corpora.
evidence_signal: On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produced 42 feasible hypotheses, achieved a 95.24% audit-assessed scientific finding rate, and outperformed the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 reviewer-dimension comparisons; key associations were supported in independent ADNI and AIBL cohorts.
watch_item: The reported finding rate is audit-assessed against frozen literature corpora, not a measure of experimentally proven causal discovery or clinical utility.
paper_title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
